title: Timed ready configuration
statement: Given finite Boolean Turing machines $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$, an input string $x$, a configuration $c$ of $D$ on $x$, and a bit $b$, define a configuration of the timed conditional machine on $x$. Its branch block is initialized from the initial configuration of the branch union of $M_1$ and $M_2$ selected by $b$, and its $D$-tape contents and head positions come from $c$; the extra tape records $b$. Its state is the control state carrying $(b,\mathrm{false})$, and its input-head position is that of $c$.
hypotheses_covered: $D$, $M_1$, and $M_2$ are finite Boolean Turing machines
